sources.subject: a cream timber orchard trellis run with emerald framing, crossed straight cream lattice slats, sparse angular mint and sage vine leaves. Diamond cut fasteners; no flowers or fruit, no circular knots.
sources.detail: The horizontal and vertical carriers are open straight lattice rail strips with NO end posts, NO legs, NO terminal blocks. The separate junction is ONE squat cream square timber vertex with emerald diamond cap and a few spear-shaped mint leaves, orthogonal top-down + short front face.
sources.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent modular 2D game sprite construction kit for Starway Ranch, one native component sheet. Scene/backdrop: genuinely transparent alpha, NO colored plate, no gradient, no cast ground shadow, no grid or labels. Style: bold graphic 2D cartoon, thick crisp almost-black navy outer outlines, simpler thin interior lines, ALL shapes constructed from long straight segments, wedges, trapezoids and clear angular corners. Flat clean broad base color plus one polygon shadow, maximum 2–3 tones per material. Palette cream/ivory timber, emerald trim, mint/sage foliage, yellow accents and slate-purple shadows matching a vivid floating ranch. Not realistic 3D, no painterly brushwork, grain, watercolor, gradients, glossy rendering, rounded clover shapes, circular badges, rounded cylinders, airbrush or pixel art.
REQUIRED EXACT CONSTRUCTION SHEET LAYOUT: landscape 1536x1024. THREE separate isolated pieces, with generous transparent gaps, never overlap:
(A) TOP LEFT: long HORIZONTAL carrier, wholly inside x0–1280,y0–420, with clear empty space around it, width about1200 and height180–260. Ends point horizontally and remain open for continuation.
(B) FAR RIGHT: long VERTICAL carrier, wholly inside x1320–1536,y0–1024, widthabout170 and heightabout850. Vertical means its route runs north–south in the image plane, viewed from above with only a short front face; draw dedicated vertical geometry, not isometric, not a tall front-view tower.
(C) BOTTOM LEFT: ONE isolated square end/corner/T/cross junction piece, wholly inside x30–600,y500–1000, about350–440 square. The junction is the shared connector, not a whole long strip.
Leave the lower middle empty. No text, symbols resembling writing, numbers, watermark, humans or animals. Preserve actual transparency. The components will be mechanically sliced, uniformly scaled and assembled into a 320x320 native tile kit, so make strong readable silhouette and usable straight continuation ports.

The separate junction is ONE squat cream square timber vertex with emerald diamond cap and a few spear-shaped mint leaves, orthogonal top-down + short front face.

sources.subject: a connected raised herb planter run made of cream boards, emerald trim and short slate-purple stone feet, filled with crisp sage and mint spear-like herb leaves. The plants visibly stand above the rim, not painted on a floor tile.
sources.detail: The horizontal and vertical carriers have continuous straight open-ended planter sides with repeated long rectangular seams and NO end walls or isolated pot boxes. The separate junction is ONE square low planter corner with angular raised herb leaves, orthogonal top-down + short front face. Do not make a plain grassy ground tile.

sources.subject: a connected low ranch footlight strip, cream timber channel with emerald bands, small warm yellow DIAMOND prism lamp inserts, slate-purple underside, near-black navy outlines. No glowing halo.
sources.detail: The horizontal and vertical carriers are continuous straight open-ended low timber lamp channels with NO terminal posts, NO closed boxed endcaps. Separate junction is ONE square cross-way cream/emerald low block with a single angular yellow diamond inset. Lamps are flat yellow facets, never round bulbs or glossy glass.
